newsitem.title: USA: CCC buys 11,670 tonnes U.S. soybean oil for Peru.
newsitem.headline: CCC buys 11,670 tonnes U.S. soybean oil for Peru.

text.p: The Commodity Credit Corp of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it bought 11,670 tonnes of U.S. bulk crude degummed soybean oil in the range of $518.84 to $525.99 a tonne, FOB, under its export program to Peru.
Shipment was slated for March 20 to April 5.
The deal included 3,890 tonnes at $519.84 a tonne, 3,890 tonnes at $523.15 and 220 tonnes at $525.99 from Bunge Corp.
An additional 670 tonnes at $520.25 a tonne, 1,000 tonnes at $522.05 and 2,000 tonnes at $525.36 were bought from Cargill Inc.
